Location: Kangaroo Point, QLD, 4169
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Centre Manager & ECT
Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
Our client is a well-established early learning provider committed to nurturing children's growth through play-based learning and holistic development. With purpose-built facilities and a team of dedicated educators, they create warm, inclusive environments where children feel safe to explore, learn and thrive. Their philosophy emphasizes emotional wellbeing, creativity and foundational skill-building during these crucial early years.
We're seeking a nurturing Childcare Worker to join their team. This role goes beyond supervision - you'll actively contribute to children's developmental milestones while fostering their curiosity through engaging, age-appropriate experiences.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

result.description:
Company ANNTAY PTY LTD t/as Sydney Hills Gymnastics 

Full job description
Sydney Hills Gymnastics is a well established gymnastics club in the Hills District . We opened our doors in 2012 in Castle Hill and have since expanded to a second venue in Bella Vista. We offer a wide range of programs, including early learning, school-age recreational classes, competitive gymnastics in MAG, WAG, and ACRO, as well as adult gymnastics.

We are seeking an experienced senior manager to Develop female participation in the Sport of Gymnastics. It is a Sports Development Officer position, a lead position that complements our developing competitive Women’s Artistic Gymnastics program.

About the Role

SALARY RANGE $82,000-$84,000 plus super

Position Description

Full Time Permanent Position of Sports Development Officer (Women’s Artistic Gymnastics)

Full Time Permanent Position of Sports Development Officer.

Sports Development Officer is responsible for establishing a high-performance gymnastics pathway, nurturing gymnasts from beginner levels to elite competition stages.

Leading a team of competitive coaches, fostering professional development and stability within the coaching team. Leasing with other mangers of programs and managing director on the subjects of development of the Women’s Artistic Gymnastics.

Leasing to relevant authorities governing Gymnastics in Australia and NSW as well as with local government and their representatives. Sports Development Officer is accountable to the Managing Director.

Qualification:

Minimum Level is Advance Silver Accredited Coach

Tertiary Education in Sport education and coaching and/or sport management, Senior First Aid Certificate

Primary Responsibilities

Promotes sports and skills development and oversees the participation of young people and other special groups in sport.

Plan and oversee the development of gymnastics participation pathways across all ages and abilities, from introductory programs to competitive streams, ensuring alignment with club goals, leading international practices and Gymnastics Australia guidelines.

Coaching, training and instructing athletes by analysing performances and developing abilities

Planning and directing performance strategies, developing performance and preparations strategies, run debrief and analysis of competitions

Motivating gymnasts and supervising their trainings

Prepare all documentations for assessments, reporting and recording of athlete progression within their allocated squad(s)

Recruiting gymnasts and coaching staff in the program

Mentor coaching staff on program delivery objectives, ensuring alignment with development goals and facilitating up-skilling opportunities where needed

Arranging entries into sporting competitions

Officiating at sporting events to enforce rules

Coordinating and directing sporting activities, and liaising with other officials to interpret and enforce rules and regulations relating to sport

Coordinate school holiday programs and term-based initiatives to boost participation

Build partnerships with schools, councils, and community groups to expand outreach.

Oversee the delivery of school-based programs and ensure smooth communication with stakeholders

Plan and deliver events such as open days, meets and community activations to increase engagement

Work with marketing to promote programs, events, and success stories across various channels

Abide by the Coaches Code of Ethics and the Youth Club Code of Ethics Reporting

Sports Development Officer is reporting directly to the Managing Director on all issues of their competency.

Programming and Planning

Organise tactical and practical plans and procedures for Program development

Develops and Implement Program Development Plan.

Together with the Program Coordinator and Head Coach prepare documentation, for the planning, selection, assessment, reporting, recording and syllabus content of the Women’s Artistic Gymnastics program.

Communication

Communicate information to members of the club as required through the available channels.

Communicate all necessary issues to the Managing Director

Educational

Continually update knowledge and education in modern gymnastics.

Present when necessary, at club’s education days, clinics, workshops . I.e. Child Protection, OHS

Fulfil all requirements as required through Gymnastics Australia in relation to the National Coaches Accreditation Scheme.

Employer: OneCare Priority Services Pty Ltd T/A One Care Priority Services
Location: Campbelltown, South Australia 5074
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: AUD $72,000 – $82,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Organization:

OneCare Priority Services is a registered NDIS service provider committed to delivering high-
quality, person-centred support to individuals with disabilities, injuries, and mental health conditions. The organisation is dedicated to promoting independence, inclusion, and dignity through tailored support services across Adelaide and surrounding regions.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Aged or Disabled Carer to provide direct care and support services in accordance with individual care plans and organisational policies. The role focuses on enhancing clients’ independence, community participation, and overall wellbeing.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

•	Provide personal care including assistance with daily living activities such as grooming, dressing, and mobility support
•	Support clients in accessing community activities, employment, and social engagement
•	Assist with implementation of individual support plans and behavioural programs
•	Monitor client wellbeing and report any concerns in accordance with organisational procedures
•	Maintain accurate documentation including client progress notes and reports
•	Support medication administration in line with company policies
•	Work collaboratively with families, carers, case managers, and allied health professionals
•	Ensure compliance with NDIS standards, workplace health and safety requirements, and internal policies

Skills and Experience:

•	AQF Certificate III in Individual support or higher relevant qualification is required.
•	A minimum of 12 months relevant experience in aged or disability care services is required, with a minimum of 20 hours per week. This experience may be gained through full-time, part-time, or casual employment.
•	Valid Australian driver license is must, along with comprehensive car insurance.
•	Applicants must be willing to accept shift allocations at client locations across metropolitan, regional, and outer regional South Australia, depending on operational requirements and client care needs. Flexibility to travel between client locations is an essential requirement of this position.
•	Strong interpersonal skills, a compassionate, patient approach.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of team.
•	A valid National Police Check, Working with Children Check and other NDIS entry level certificates are required.
•	First Aid, Manual Handling and CPR Certificate is required.
Additional Requirements:
•	Ability to perform physical tasks including manual handling and mobility support
•	Willingness to undertake ongoing training including WHS, infection control, and medication administration

BENEFITS

•	Work in a supportive and inclusive team environment.
•	Opportunities for career development and training.
•	Flexible working arrangements to suit your lifestyle.
•	Meaningful work where you make a real impact.
•	Opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of others


ABOUT US

One Care Priority Services is a South Australia-based disability support provider located at 567 Lower North East Road, Campbelltown SA 5074, committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred services to individuals living with disabilities, injuries, and mental health conditions. The organisation operates across Adelaide and surrounding regions, supporting participants under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).

The company is focused on enhancing the quality of life of its clients by providing tailored support services that promote independence, dignity, and active participation in the community. All services are delivered in accordance with NDIS Practice Standards, relevant legislation, and organisational policies.

The position is also responsible for a broad range of Nursing and Midwifery matters as well as ensuring appropriate emergency responses after hours.

About Our Client
Our client is an award-winning luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant and sophisticated urban destination. This dynamic precinct is a celebrated hub where luxury accommodation meets an exclusive collection of high-end retail, award-winning restaurants, and stylish bars. The culinary philosophy is centred on creating immersive, memorable experiences through innovative, produce-driven cuisine and impeccable service in a stylish and energetic atmosphere. They are seeking a dedicated Food & Beverage Attendant who embodies this modern, sophisticated ethos to deliver exceptional service in their acclaimed dining venues.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a passionate and skilled Food & Beverage Attendant (Trade Waiter) to join the dynamic team within their flagship restaurant. This role is the backbone of the guest dining experience, requiring a keen eye for detail, a warm and engaging personality, and a deep commitment to service excellence. You will be responsible for guiding guests through their culinary journey, from the initial greeting to the final farewell, ensuring every interaction reflects the venue’s reputation for sophistication and energy.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
Beverage Service & Sales Enhancement
• Skillfully open bottles at the table and pour beverages, including wine, beer, and non-alcoholic drinks, adhering to professional service standards and enhancing the sense of occasion for guests.
• Proactively monitor and maintain guest tables, promptly removing empty bottles and used glasses, and refilling water and other beverages to ensure an uninterrupted and attentive service flow.
• Confidently recommend wines from our curated list to complement specific food selections, developing your knowledge to expertly pair flavours and enhance the overall culinary experience for our guests.

Operational Excellence & Venue Presentation
• Meticulously set and arrange tables prior to service, ensuring all cutlery, glassware, and tableware are polished, correctly positioned, and meet the highest standards of presentation for a luxury venue.
• Efficiently clear tables between courses, returning dishes and cutlery to the kitchen, and swiftly resetting tables to the pristine standard required for the next seating without disrupting the ambient atmosphere.
• Accurately process guest payments by operating the point-of-sale system and cash register, handling all financial transactions with integrity and providing guests with a smooth and efficient conclusion to their visit.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Previous experience in a similar food and beverage service role, preferably within a high-volume, à la carte or fine-dining environment.
• A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service with a warm, confident, and engaging personality.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build instant rapport with guests and work seamlessly within a team.
• A strong interest in food, wine, and beverage trends, with a willingness to learn and develop knowledge of menu items and wine pairings.
• Impeccable personal presentation and a professional demeanour that aligns with a luxury brand.
• The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment, maintaining composure and a high attention to detail under pressure.
• Flexibility to work across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

To Apply
If you are a hospitality professional with a passion for delivering unforgettable guest experiences, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your interest in this role.

Please note: All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment partner for this role and our client's identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

In this rewarding opportunity you will join the St Vincent's Private Hospital Melbourne (SVPHM) team as Associate Nurse Unit Manager in our Central Sterilising Services Department (CSSD) at our Fitzroy campus.
